messages:
Maria (PM): quick sync — we need to lock down auth & tenant model for the upcoming API milestone (chat + streaming + function-calls + embeddings). security flagged rotation UX, sales flagged project scoping. can we align on scope now?

Ajay (Eng): yep. infra questions: how will key rotation affect long-running streaming sessions and token reuse? do we need a token introspection endpoint or can we validate locally?

Lisa (Security): rotation is non-negotiable for SOC2 customers. recommend short-lived session tokens (~1h) and long-lived project/org keys for server-to-server flows with KMS. must have immediate revoke and audit trail.

Tom (Sales): customers want project-scoped keys so teams can separate dev/prod billing and restrict embeddings. some asked for rotation without touching existing integrations.

Sarah (CS): two customers already had leaks and wanted to revoke a key without dropping active conversations. need graceful session handoff.

Ajay (Eng): current streaming uses bearer key in WS header; revoking closes connections now. proposal: ephemeral session tokens minted from a long-lived project key. validate JWT at edge to avoid per-message introspection.

Maria (PM): proposal: 1) org- and project-level keys with scopes; 2) staged rotation API (create new key, grace window, deprecate old); 3) /v1/sessions to mint ephemeral tokens for streaming. thoughts?

Lisa (Security): staged rotation + grace window ok. require audit events for create/rotate/revoke and outbound webhook for immediate revocation so customer SRE can sync.

Ajay (Eng): implementation idea: minted token = short-lived JWT with claims {project, scopes, jti}. Edges validate signature; for emergency revoke keep a revocation blacklist (redis) keyed by jti+project with TTL = token TTL. edges subscribe to revocation pub/sub.

Tom (Sales): will project claims break mobile SDK usage? many customers embed a single API key in mobile apps.

Sarah (CS): recommend backend-for-token-minting for mobile. provide SDK helpers and docs showing ephemeral flow and mobile examples.

Ajay (Eng): SDK helper: mintSession(project_id, scopes) -> fetch ephemeral token; update streaming examples. Backwards compat: existing org keys continue to work.

Maria (PM): draft launch checklist: API: /v1/keys CRUD + rotate + audit events ✅; Sessions: /v1/sessions mint JWT + revocation ✅; Scoping: org/project + comma-separated scopes ✅; SDKs: JS + Python helper + migration guide ⏳; Docs: rotation flow, ephemeral tokens, mobile guidance ⏳; Canary: 10% orgs, monitor key-error-rate + streaming disconnects ⏳; Security: design review + threat model + KMS/HSM integration ✅.

Lisa (Security): add requirement: org-configurable default TTL for ephemeral tokens, org-settable max <= 24h. must provide a one-click "revoke all sessions for project" that publishes revocation events.

Ajay (Eng): will implement revocation pub/sub; edge nodes drop sessions whose jti/project match. add rate-limit on /v1/sessions to prevent abuse.

Maria (PM): prioritization: P0 for Dedicated/Private, P1 for hosted. sequence: 1) Keys API + audit + KMS; 2) Sessions + revocation; 3) SDKs + docs; 4) Canary + GA.

Tom (Sales): need migration guidance for customers using a single global key. produce a 1-pager + hands-on migration help for top 10 accounts.

Sarah (CS): product idea: managed rotation (we rotate monthly) as an enterprise add-on.

Maria (PM): exec decision: require SDK helpers before GA or ship GA with docs + SDK PRs shortly after? I recommend shipping with JS and Python helpers available before GA.

Ajay (Eng): timeline: Keys API + KMS + audit = 2 sprints. Sessions + revocation = 2 sprints. SDKs/docs + QA + canary = 1 sprint. total ~5 sprints.

Lisa (Security): security asks: pen test on session mint endpoint, WAF rules, anomaly detection on mint rates, HSM-backed key storage.

Maria (PM): action items: Ajay: stub /v1/sessions + revocation pubsub PR by EOD Fri; Lisa: finalize security checklist + TTL policy by Thu EOD; Tom/Sarah: migration one-pager by Thu EOD; Maria: spec + prioritization board PR Mon AM.

infra-bot: deploy-notice: meeting recorded and uploaded to #product/notes https://company.zoom/rec/abc123

Ajay (Eng): will post API draft and example curl + SDK snippets in this thread when PR is open.
